facts.fact: KNBS publishes the second Kenya Strategy for Development of Statistics (KSDS II) for 2023/24-2027/28 for download as the national statistical system strategy; no adoption date is given, so the document's published date is used.
The first Kenya Strategy for Development of Statistics (KSDS I) was developed and implemented for 2019/20-2022/23, a period that has ended; KSDS II followed it.
KSDS I was evaluated in 2023, with document reviews, stakeholder consultations and risk analyses, and the evaluation informed the development of KSDS II.
